text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for annual plans. Monthly plans are not refundable but can be cancelled anytime.
Single sign-on (SAML and OIDC) is available on the Business and Enterprise plans only.
Customer data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt) or US (Iowa) region, chosen at signup. Region cannot be changed later without a support-assisted migration.
The Enterprise plan includes a 99.95% monthly uptime SLA with service credits. Other plans have no SLA.
The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. Bursts above that receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
Starter costs $9 per user per month, Business costs $29 per user per month, Enterprise is custom priced.
